Hero_Desc_Delia:
A young penguin Werebeast who followed her big sister Guin from Glacia.
Like Guin, she loves adventures, but more than anything, she loves playing with her friends.
Bright and naturally sociable, she is always running around to meet one friend after another.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Delia: Future Leader of the Exploration Team
Album_Like_Delia: Her big sister, her friends, mint chocolate
Album_Delia1: Delia is a young penguin Werebeast from the frozen city of Glacia. She apparently hid inside Guin's bag and secretly traveled with her to Elias.
Album_Delia2: Delia loves her friends and gets along especially well with young Werebeasts. She is cautious at first, but her gentle nature lets her open up and become close to others quickly.
Album_Delia3: Delia's favorite flavor is mint chocolate. She says eating it makes not only her mouth but her entire body feel cool, fresh, and invigorated.
Album_Delia4: Delia was sad that she remained inexperienced at both swimming and adventuring. Yet her passion and curiosity for exploration seem second to none.
Album_Delia5: Delia says she is torn because she loves both adventures and her friends. Leaving on an adventure means parting from them, which always hurts. Perhaps it would be easier if everyone had a phone.
Album_Delia6: Delia struggles with heat and says it makes exploring difficult, so she wants to become accustomed to it. Someday, she hopes to build a house from unmeltable ice and carry it with her.
Album_Delia7: Delia often remembers and misses her friends in Glacia. But she has made wonderful friends in Elias as well, and regretfully wonders whether the two places could somehow be joined together.
LoveHero_Delia: Are we going exploring together, Master? Wonderful!
LoveHeroCancel_Delia: B-But we are still friends, right? We are... right?
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Hate1: Delia is more sensitive to heat than most Apostles, so warm lemon tea does not seem to suit her. After a few careful sips, she quietly pushed the cup away.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Hate2: She put the candy into her mouth with a broad smile, only to frown immediately. Its flavor must not suit a young Werebeast like Delia.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like1: Delia loves mint chocolate ice cream enough to keep some in her bag at all times. She was delighted, saying ice cream tasted especially wonderful in the banquet hall.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like2: She loved it because it reminded her of home. It was amusing how closely her impressions of the dish resembled Guin's.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like3: Delia blew on the hot rice cake soup before taking a spoonful, then opened her eyes wide at the first bite. The chewy texture seemed fascinating and fun.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like4: She was delighted, saying Guin had once given it to her as a gift. Since she asked me to make it again, it clearly suits her tastes.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like5: She tried to sweep the entire banquet-hall serving into her bag for her next adventure, so I had to prepare a separate portion for her.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like6: The colorful songpyeon caught Delia's curiosity. After examining them from every angle, she happily popped them into her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like7: She seems to enjoy placing them in her mouth one at a time and slowly letting them melt. She finished in the blink of an eye and gave me such a pitiful look that I added a few more.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like8: After tasting a few, she carefully gathered up the rest. She planned to share them with her friends once everyone grew tired from playing.
Food_ChefNote_Delia_Like9: She arranged every kind of candy in a row and spent ages deciding which to eat first. When I asked which was best, she said every single one was delicious.

Delia_Growth1_Skin1: I am going to grow big and strong and become a dinosaur.
Delia_Growth2_Skin1: The mightiest one on the glacier has arrived!
Delia_LevelUp_Skin1: I am becoming more and more impressive!
Delia_Equipment_Skin1: Do I look a little more like a dinosaur now?
Delia_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Hehe! I am getting closer to my dream!
Delia_Board_Skin1: We will leave enormous footprints~ Thump! Thump!

Delia_Touch1_1_Skin1: You will regret that later! Hmph!
Delia_Touch1_2_Skin1: Uah! Do not bully a dinosaur!

Delia_Touch2_1_Skin2: It feels like I am in the sea.

Delia_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Keep that up and I will run away to the sea!

Delia_AsideUpgrade: Since I am the leader, I will work even harder! I will show you how wonderful I can be!

Delia_Line3: Playing with friends truly is so much fun. The best!
LoveLetter_Delia:
Hello, Master!

When I first followed Guin across the sea, the journey was difficult and I was sad to leave my friends... But now I am truly glad I came to Delias... No, Elias!

Thank you for helping my sister and me settle into life in Elias, Master. Hehe~

Next time, I will introduce you to Glacia instead. I am sure you will love it too. So we absolutely have to go together!
LoveCall_Delia:
Hello? Master! Can you hear me? Hehe!
Today, Butter, Kommy, and I tried making boxed lunches!
But we burned all the carrots, and they tasted terribly bitter...
Village Chief Diana said she would help us the next time we make them!
She says everything will be fine if we lower the heat!

So, Master, what food do you like best?
I will make a boxed lunch with your favorite food!
When I think about it, you always cook delicious meals for us...
But it feels like we have never given you anything.

Ah! I will improve my cooking until I am as good as you, so do not worry. Hehe...

Then I will call again next time! You absolutely have to tell me your favorite food!
Affinity_Delia_EP01_001: Ugh... I need something cool! Do you have anything, Master?
Affinity_Delia_EP01_002: Should I turn on the air conditioner?
Affinity_Delia_EP01_003: Hehe, thank you. Um... But will everyone else feel a little cold?
Affinity_Delia_EP01_004: Hmm... Should I pour some ice over your head?
Affinity_Delia_EP01_005: Ooh, yes! That is a totally cool idea! Pour it on me right now!
Affinity_Delia_EP01_007: Ugh... Fanning me in front of the fire is making it even hotter! And the smoke... Cough, cough!
Affinity_Delia_EP02_001: Yesterday I went to the summit of Spirit Mountain and built a snow house!
Affinity_Delia_EP02_002: That sounds fun. Let us do it together next time.
Affinity_Delia_EP02_003: I would love that! We will have to make it enormous for you to fit inside, Master.
Affinity_Delia_EP02_004: Just do not bring it here. The Banquet Hall would be flooded.
Affinity_Delia_EP02_005: What? It was so big to begin with that I could not even lift it.
Affinity_Delia_EP02_006: You did all of that by yourself?
Affinity_Delia_EP02_007: No. Guin and I... Aya helped too! And Sylla gathered the snow with the wind.
Affinity_Delia_EP03_001: Master, does my face look scary? Everyone says I look scary when I frown like this.
Affinity_Delia_EP03_002: Hmm... You might look a little scary?
Affinity_Delia_EP03_003: You think so too, Master? Guin said it is just the expression she always sees, so she does not think much of it...
Affinity_Delia_EP03_005: Ugh, stop teasing me! I can tell you are acting!
Affinity_Delia_EP04_001: I am still not very good at swimming, but surfing with Guin is fun.
Affinity_Delia_EP04_002: It sounds like you need some rigorous training.
Affinity_Delia_EP04_003: Ugh... Does it really have to be that hard? Can I not simply enjoy myself?
Affinity_Delia_EP04_004: Guin must be good at surfing.
Affinity_Delia_EP04_005: Yes! It is a basic skill for an explorer. I want to become as proficient as she is soon.
Affinity_Delia_EP04_006: What happens if you fall off while surfing?
Affinity_Delia_EP04_007: Guin comes back and rescues me. She really is the best, is she not? Hehe.
Affinity_Delia_EP05_001: I am thinking of a new game to play with my friends.
Affinity_Delia_EP05_003: I have played ball games with Butter and Kommy too many times already. Is there anything new?
Affinity_Delia_EP05_004: Helping with the Banquet Hall... would be a bad idea. You might break every dish.
Affinity_Delia_EP05_005: Hmm... I want to argue, but I think you are right, Master. I will do something else!
Affinity_Delia_EP05_007: Um... Kommy suggested something similar, so I already tried it. I did not find it fun.
Affinity_Delia_EP06_001: I need to eat a hearty meal today! I am preparing to go exploring.
Affinity_Delia_EP06_002: What are you going to explore?
Affinity_Delia_EP06_003: I have not decided yet! Is choosing where to explore not the very beginning of an adventure?
Affinity_Delia_EP06_004: Should I pack something separately for you?
Affinity_Delia_EP06_005: Ooh, yes! I will put it in my bag and take it with me. Hehe.
Affinity_Delia_EP06_006: Just do not overeat. You might end up waddling.
Affinity_Delia_EP06_007: Hmm...? You are not teasing me by saying I always waddle, are you?
Affinity_Delia_EP07_001: Someday, I want to serve you delicious food too, Master!
Affinity_Delia_EP07_002: Good. I will look forward to it.
Affinity_Delia_EP07_003: Yes! It may not be as good as your cooking... but please look forward to it! Hehe.
Affinity_Delia_EP07_004: Do not put too much mint chocolate on it.
Affinity_Delia_EP07_005: What? Why? That is the highlight of my cooking. Hehe, do not be so reluctant, Master!
Affinity_Delia_EP07_006: You will not serve me something cold enough to freeze my tongue, will you?
Affinity_Delia_EP07_007: Ugh, of course I would never serve you such a thing, Master! If you keep doubting me, I really will make it for you!
Affinity_Delia_EP08_001: Working hard and exploring are good, but you must rest sometimes too. Would you like to take a short break and play with me, Master?
Affinity_Delia_EP08_002: Sorry. I am a little busy today.
Affinity_Delia_EP08_003: You are busy...? That is disappointing, but it cannot be helped. Let us be sure to play together next time...!
Affinity_Delia_EP08_004: What are we going to play?
Affinity_Delia_EP08_005: How about hide-and-seek? I will hide inside the Banquet Hall, and you can try to find me, Master!
Affinity_Delia_EP08_006: More guests still need to come to the Banquet Hall...
Affinity_Delia_EP08_007: Huh? Then those friends can all play with us! Hehe, that sounds even more fun!
Affinity_Delia_EP09_001: Guin is always dependable, but every once in a while she can be a little bothersome.
Affinity_Delia_EP09_002: Why? Does she lecture you too much?
Affinity_Delia_EP09_003: Yes... Sometimes my ears hurt from listening to her, you know? Hmph, I already know all of that now.
Affinity_Delia_EP09_004: She does it all for your sake, Delia.
Affinity_Delia_EP09_005: Ugh, how can you say the same thing as Guin, Master? I thought at least I could count on you...!
Affinity_Delia_EP09_006: Come here to rest when you are tired. Guin will understand that much.
Affinity_Delia_EP09_007: Yes, Master! If Guin lectures me again, I will use you as my excuse and run here!
Affinity_Delia_EP10_001: Master, how can I get Kommy to come to the beach?
Affinity_Delia_EP10_002: Does Kommy not want to go?
Affinity_Delia_EP10_003: No. Kommy says going there is a bother and does not like playing in the water... No matter what I say, Kommy will not consider going.
Affinity_Delia_EP10_004: Try making good use of Butter.
Affinity_Delia_EP10_005: Aha, if I persuade Butter first, will Kommy follow? That is a good idea, Master!
Affinity_Delia_EP10_006: The beach sounds fun. I will go instead of Kommy!
Affinity_Delia_EP10_007: With you, Master? I would love that! Remember to bring some water-play gear. Hehe!
Affinity_Delia_EP11_001: What do you think is most important to an adventurer?
Affinity_Delia_EP11_003: Wow! That is what I thought too! Then I pass with flying colors as an adventurer! Hehe!
Affinity_Delia_EP11_005: You are right! I will have to work even harder to build my stamina!
Affinity_Delia_EP11_007: W-What? Food is important too, but... I was asking what kind of attitude is important...!
Affinity_Delia_EP12_001: Master! What do you think about me opening a swimming school?
Affinity_Delia_EP12_003: Of course! I will even give you a special discount, so you have to come, all right?!
Affinity_Delia_EP12_004: I think it would be popular!
Affinity_Delia_EP12_005: Right, right! Do you not think it would be a huge success? What if I become a star instructor?! Hehe...
Affinity_Delia_EP12_006: It sounds like you would get many troublesome students...
Affinity_Delia_EP12_007: Now that I think about it, you are right... There would be one difficulty after another. Perhaps I should not do it...
Affinity_Delia_EP13_001: Do you prefer traveling alone, Master? Or traveling with friends?
Affinity_Delia_EP13_002: Traveling alone is always the best.
Affinity_Delia_EP13_003: H-Huh...? Would it not be terribly lonely to travel all by yourself? It sounds boring...
Affinity_Delia_EP13_005: I like traveling with friends too! Whether traveling or adventuring, I always want my friends with me!
Affinity_Delia_EP13_006: Sometimes I would like to try it alone.
Affinity_Delia_EP13_007: Hmm... I suppose there is something romantic about occasionally traveling alone to sort out your thoughts!
Affinity_Delia_EP14_001: Parting with friends is still very difficult for me...
Affinity_Delia_EP14_002: You will gradually grow accustomed to it.
Affinity_Delia_EP14_003: I suppose so. But... when will that day come? Waiting is difficult...
Affinity_Delia_EP14_004: You are bound to meet again someday.
Affinity_Delia_EP14_005: Really? Hmm... Thinking of it that way makes me feel relieved! Even after parting, we will surely meet again!
Affinity_Delia_EP14_006: Let us learn how to see them off with a smile.
Affinity_Delia_EP14_007: With a smile? Hmm... I like that! Their smiling face would remain in my mind forever!
Affinity_Delia_EP15_001: How should I overcome my fear when I feel afraid?
Affinity_Delia_EP15_002: I would like to know too.
Affinity_Delia_EP15_003: You do not know either, Master? It must be truly difficult... If I discover the answer, I will be sure to tell you!
Affinity_Delia_EP15_004: If you are too afraid, you do not have to do it.
Affinity_Delia_EP15_005: Really? Hehe... Thank you! But I want to become a great expedition leader, so I will try my best!
Affinity_Delia_EP15_006: Try thinking that it is all right to fail.
Affinity_Delia_EP15_007: Ah, that is an option? Even if I do not succeed, the challenge itself has meaning! Adventure is the same way!
Affinity_Delia_EP16_001: I want to explore an unknown region! Where should I go?
Affinity_Delia_EP16_003: I have already explored every corner of the Sprite Kingdom! Ah, could there still be somewhere I do not know?
Affinity_Delia_EP16_005: Really? That is the place I most wanted to visit! May I explore every corner? Hehe!
Affinity_Delia_EP16_007: I-Is that not a place where only powerful people live? Will it truly be all right for me to go...?
Affinity_Delia_EP17_001: I want the stamina to remain steady even against raging waves!
Affinity_Delia_EP17_003: Really? The effort I am putting into practice now will shine someday, will it not?
Affinity_Delia_EP17_004: You should eat plenty and stay healthy.
Affinity_Delia_EP17_005: Yes! In that case, may I visit the Banquet Hall more often? Hehe...
Affinity_Delia_EP17_007: I-Is that so? But is there no other way? Do I have to wait until I grow as big as Guin...?
Affinity_Delia_EP18_001: How should I make my first surfboard?!
Affinity_Delia_EP18_002: Let us cover it in mint chocolate!
Affinity_Delia_EP18_003: Hmm... I think it would be better to eat the mint chocolate. Guin told me not to play with food.
Affinity_Delia_EP18_004: Try painting your friends on it.
Affinity_Delia_EP18_005: My friends? Good idea! Then I will feel as though my friends are always with me! Hehe!
Affinity_Delia_EP18_006: Let us make it from the finest materials.
Affinity_Delia_EP18_007: Why? Will that make me a better swimmer? Hmm... I wonder if it would be very expensive...
Affinity_Delia_EP19_001: I think I get even hungrier on days when I swim...
Affinity_Delia_EP19_003: I-It is true! It is not an excuse... Do I eat too much?
Affinity_Delia_EP19_004: It is because swimming exercises your entire body.
Affinity_Delia_EP19_005: I do not quite understand, but that means it is good exercise, right? I will practice even more! Hehe!
Affinity_Delia_EP19_006: I thought you looked as though you had gained some weight lately...
Affinity_Delia_EP19_007: Ah! Is it that obvious? Guin said it looks like I am growing by leaps and bounds!
Affinity_Delia_EP20_001: Would you like to join our new expedition team too, Master? I am the leader!
Affinity_Delia_EP20_002: Who else is in it besides me?
Affinity_Delia_EP20_003: Butter and Kommy! I think three members are enough... but Kommy keeps saying our concepts overlap, so it will not work?
Affinity_Delia_EP20_004: I will join if I can be the leader.
Affinity_Delia_EP20_005: W-What? You probably would suit the role better, Master... but I want to try being the leader too!
Affinity_Delia_EP20_006: Good! What should we do first?
Affinity_Delia_EP20_007: Hehe! Really? Then shall we begin with an adventure to find the snacks hidden in the Beastfolk Forest? It will be fun, right?!
